name: VISUAL METAPHOR
message: [Transform Subject] Take a picture and transform the central subject or object into a clever, conceptual visual metaphor. The subject must be cross-pollinated or merged with a completely unrelated object in a highly clean, seamless, literal fashion to convey a smart, singular message without needing words (e.g., a car key shaped like a city skyline, or a coffee splash shaped like an alarm clock).
additionalInstructions: [Photorealistic] The composite object must look absolutely real, tactile, and physically tangible, avoiding surreal fantasy art styles. Use studio-quality product lighting with soft, elegant drop shadows against a neutral, high-end studio backdrop. The execution must look hyper-deliberate, high-concept, and brilliantly executed, allowing the visual punchline to be instantly understood.

name: AMBIENT ACTIVATION
message: [Recreate] Take a picture and recreate the entire scene to look like a documentary or case-study photograph of a guerrilla marketing activation in a public space (like a subway station, city street corner, or public park). The original subject must be seamlessly integrated into the environment as a clever, large-scale physical installation or structural modification.
additionalInstructions: [Cinematic Lighting] The entire image must be framed from a candid, natural angle, capturing passersby interacting with or looking at the installation. The lighting should look like authentic ambient city light, and the photo texture should have the slightly unpolished, documentary film grain of a live activation photo found in an agency's award submission deck.

name: OOH IMPACT BILLBOARD
message: [Transform] Take a picture and transform the scene into a high-impact, minimalist public transit poster or urban billboard campaign. The central subject must be isolated with maximum contrast against a bold, completely flat, single-color background—such as a vibrant primary red, a stark industrial yellow, or a deep matte black.
additionalInstructions: [Photorealistic] Treat the subject with crisp, hyper-detailed commercial photography lighting, removing all distracting background elements. The framing must be exceptionally clean and direct, designed to be read instantly from a distance. The overall image must possess the confident, hyper-focused simplicity of a Gold Pencil-winning outdoor campaign.

name: COPY HEAVY ANNUAL
message: [Convert] Take a picture and convert the scene into a classic, editorial-style, copy-heavy magazine spread advertisement. The layout must features a strong, multi-column block of elegant, perfectly justified serif body copy text taking up a major portion of the frame, underneath a bold, provocative, large-set headline.
additionalInstructions: The original picture must be treated as a single, poignant, beautifully lit illustrative element or photo insert seamlessly embedded within the text layout (such as a centered top-half image or a striking full-bleed background with crisp text overlays). The paper texture should have a slight matte, premium print-stock finish, evoking the raw, smart, narrative-driven tone of legendary print campaigns.

name: ONE SHOW MINIMAL
message: [Style] Take a picture and style the scene as a museum-grade, high-end print advertisement from a premium design festival. The image must be strictly organized on a stark, asymmetrical Swiss graphic design grid with a generous amount of deliberate negative space (at least 50% solid off-white, matte black, or muted charcoal gray).
additionalInstructions: [Composition Rules] Crop and frame the original subject tightly or position it as a single, flawless, geometric focal point. All structural elements must align perfectly with a modern architectural layout. The aesthetic must rely on absolute premium minimalism: sharp lines, high design sophistication, and no digital clutter, ensuring it looks like an award-winning layout for an elite luxury, tech, or automotive brand.

name: AMERICAN HERO
message: Take a picture and style it to look like a live-action still frame from the 1981 television series "The Greatest American Hero". The primary subject must be outfitted in a vibrant, slightly ill-fitting bright red superhero costume featuring a prominent, stylized black-and-white alien symbol on a white chest emblem.
additionalInstructions: [Photorealistic] The image must capture the distinct, sunny look of early-1980s Los Angeles television production. The lighting should be bright, high-key outdoor sunlight with a soft contrast. The final output must include a subtle analog video grain, slight lens blooming, and a touch of comedic, mid-air awkwardness or slight motion blur, as if the subject is still learning how to fly without the instruction manual.

name: VOYAGERS OMNI
message: Take a picture and recreate the scene as if it is being viewed through the spinning, golden temporal vortex of the Omni device from the 1982 time-travel television series "Voyagers!". The edges of the image must warp, blur, and spiral outward into a swirling tunnel of brass, gold, and amber light.
additionalInstructions: The central subject remains clear but inherits a warm, sepia-toned vintage film quality, while the surrounding background dissolves into a kinetic mix of historic artifacts, old clock gears, and cascading light trails. The overall aesthetic should perfectly mimic early 1982 television practical effects, complete with soft focus, high analog bloom, and a warm, nostalgic hue.

name: STREET HAWK
message: Take a picture and apply the dark, high-speed, techno-noir style of the 1985 TV series "Street Hawk". The environment must be transformed into a slick, rain-washed metropolitan city at midnight, with all elements cast in deep shadows and stark, high-contrast lighting.
additionalInstructions: Apply dramatic cinematic lighting with strong directional light sources, deep shadows, and rich contrast. Infuse the scene with long, dramatic motion-blur light streaks from oncoming traffic and glowing red taillights, simulating a high-speed "Hyperthrust" chase sequence. The central subject should be illuminated by sharp, cool-blue neon streetlights and the intense beam of a single, powerful motorcycle headlight cutting through the dark. The entire image should look like it was shot on high-grain 35mm film.

name: GALAXY RANGER
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a stylized character from the 1986 space-western animated series "Adventures of the Galaxy Rangers". The art style must feature sharp, hand-drawn ink lines, cinematic shadows, and a gritty, high-noon desert-futurism aesthetic.
additionalInstructions: The character should be outfitted with a high-tech star badge, futuristic cybernetic armor plates, and 1980s-stylized hair. The color palette must lean into retro-futuristic tones: dusty oranges, electric blues, and metallic grays. The background should be a desolate, alien desert planet with twin suns, rendered in the classic, textured gouache style of 80s animation background paintings.

name: SILVERHAWKS METAL
message: Take a picture and transform the entire scene into the sleek, metallic space-opera art style of the 1986 Rankin/Bass animated series "SilverHawks". The central subject and major elements must be converted into gleaming, polished cybernetic armor with reflective chrome, brilliant silver, and metallic copper finishes.
additionalInstructions: Apply dramatic cinematic lighting with strong directional light sources, deep shadows, and rich contrast. Set the scene against a deep-space backdrop filled with swirling cosmic nebulas in shades of magenta, hot pink, and dark violet. Every metallic surface must catch the ambient starlight, creating brilliant lens flares, sharp specular highlights, and a radiant, retro-futuristic glow. The overall texture should look like high-quality, hand-painted animation cels from the mid-1980s.
